title: Breaking Enchantment
description: This mod adds a new enchantment called "Breaking", which makes tools and armor break faster.
body:
## This mod adds a new enchantment: Breaking.

**Version:** NeoForge 1.21.8

In the creative tab, there will be 2 breaking books; _**use the one that does not say "Breaking Error 67"**_ _(it is an unexpected error)_

**_What does it do?_**

_- The new breaking enchant will make tools and armor break faster (depending on the enchantment level)._

**NOTE:** Breaking can't coexist with unbreaking at the same time.






Please tell me if there's a bug.
